description: Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the unweighted mean of the station averages.

a.request: Average the bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) of the telescopes at each observatory station, ignoring missing values. Take as the baseline the average of those station averages (each station counting once). For the stations whose average is above that baseline, return one row with two unrounded values: the mean of those stations' averages, and the mean amount by which they exceed the baseline.
a.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL GROUP BY observstation), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(station_avg) as baseline_value FROM station_avg), above_baseline AS (SELECT sa.station_avg, sa.station_avg - b.baseline_value as excess FROM station_avg sa CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE sa.station_avg > b.baseline_value) SELECT AVG(station_avg) as mean_of_above_baseline_averages, AVG(excess) as mean_excess FROM above_baseline

c.request: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage (`bandusagepct`) is above average, what is their mean bandwidth usage, and how far above average are they on average? Ignore missing usage values, and give both figures unrounded in a single row. Compare each station's average bandwidth usage with the unweighted mean of the station averages.
c.sql:
WITH station_avgs AS (
  SELECT 
    observstation,
    AVG(bandusagepct) as station_avg
  FROM telescopes
  WHERE bandusagepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY observstation
),
station_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(station_avg) as mean_val
  FROM station_avgs
),
above_average_stations AS (
  SELECT sa.station_avg
  FROM station_avgs sa
  WHERE sa.station_avg > (SELECT mean_val FROM station_mean)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(aas.station_avg) as mean_bandwidth_usage,
  AVG(aas.station_avg) - (SELECT mean_val FROM station_mean) as above_average
FROM above_average_stations aas

d.request: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage exceeds the unweighted mean of all station averages, return their collective mean bandwidth usage and their average deviation above that overall mean.
d.sql:
WITH station_averages AS (
  SELECT 
    o.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as station_avg_bandwidth
  FROM telescopes t
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  GROUP BY o.observstation
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(station_avg_bandwidth) as overall_mean_bandwidth
  FROM station_averages
)
SELECT 
  AVG(sa.station_avg_bandwidth) as collective_mean_bandwidth,
  AVG(sa.station_avg_bandwidth - om.overall_mean_bandwidth) as average_deviation_above_mean
FROM station_averages sa
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE sa.station_avg_bandwidth > om.overall_mean_bandwidth

b.request: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage is above the mean of all station-level average bandwidth usages, return the mean bandwidth usage across those stations and their mean deviation above the overall station-average mean, with both values unrounded in a single row.
b.sql:
WITH station_avg_bandwidth AS (
  SELECT 
    t.observstation,
    AVG(t.bandusagepct) as station_avg_bandwidth
  FROM telescopes t
  GROUP BY t.observstation
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(station_avg_bandwidth) as overall_avg
  FROM station_avg_bandwidth
)
SELECT 
  AVG(sab.station_avg_bandwidth) as mean_bandwidth_usage,
  AVG(sab.station_avg_bandwidth - om.overall_avg) as mean_deviation_above_overall
FROM station_avg_bandwidth sab
CROSS JOIN overall_mean om
WHERE sab.station_avg_bandwidth > om.overall_avg
b.raw: For observatory stations whose average telescope bandwidth usage is above the mean of all station-level average bandwidth usages, return the mean bandwidth usage across those stations and their mean deviation above the overall station-average mean, with both values unrounded in a single row.
